items.title: My husband is happily retired at 64 and thinks I should keep working. Is he being fair?
items.description: “I’m exhausted. My alarm goes off at 6 a.m., and I have a 50-minute commute.”

items.title: My wife is bankrolling her family’s trips to New York and it’s draining our savings. Should I ask her to stop?
items.description: “Hotel rooms can cost as much as $400 per night.”

items.title: I’m in my 40s. Should I accept a lower pension in exchange for naming my husband or child as a beneficiary?
items.description: “If I die before my husband, he will receive a lifetime pension equal to 50%–66% of my monthly benefit.”

items.title: ‘It’s downright dirty’: My brother moved in with our ailing mother and closed her bank account. What can I do?
items.description: “It is devastating when the people you should be able to trust become the very people you have to protect yourself from.”

items.title: ‘I’ve been a stay-at-home mom’: I’m 50 and have a chronic illness. My husband lost his job. Should he raid his 401(k)?
items.description: “Our financial and healthcare situation has become increasingly concerning.”

items.title: ‘Buyers are out for blood’: With home sales at a record low, buyers are calling the shots
items.description: The few buyers left in the market braving record-high home prices and 7% mortgage rates are starting to call the shots, real-estate agents say.

items.title: America is definitely rich enough to fix Social Security and Medicare. Here’s how.
items.description: This one, simple, low-pain tax solves all the problems.

items.description: There are plenty of rich and influential women in the U.S. Their time may be coming.

items.title: Is Social Security a Ponzi scheme? No. Don’t get carried away with 1930s-era prophecies of doom.
items.description: Wisconsin Republican Sen. Ron Johnson called Social Security a “scam” and urged lawmakers to shut it down.

items.title: ‘I’m sick of flying’: I paid for priority boarding, but the overhead bins were full. Was I duped?
items.description: “Maybe next time I’ll try the other approach: I’ll board whenever I feel like it and drop my suitcase in the first open slot I see.”
